Frequently Asked Questions

Common Questions

What exactly is included in the Complete Bundle?

All 5 books — the full 150-day roadmap from idea to mastery — plus all 6 bonuses: the Idea Finder Workbook, Website Planning Workbook, Launch Checklist, SOP Templates Pack, CEO Dashboard Planner, and the Prompt Vault.

Do I need to buy the books in order, or can I use the bundle right away?

The bundle unlocks everything at once. The books are designed to be worked through in order — Roadmap, Growth, Sales, Automation, Mastery — but you're free to move at your own pace.

Is this a good fit if I'm a complete beginner?

Yes. Book 1 assumes no prior experience and starts with choosing an idea. Later books get progressively more advanced as your business grows.

How will the bundle be delivered once it launches?

On launch, everything will be delivered as an instant digital download, with lifetime access to future updates for every book and bonus.

Will I be able to buy the books individually?

Yes, each book will also be available on its own at launch. The Complete Bundle is planned to offer better value than buying every book and bonus separately.

Is the bundle available to purchase right now?

Not yet. The Complete Bundle is launching March 2027. Joining the waitlist is completely free and reserves your spot for early access and special launch pricing.

What happens after I join the waitlist?

You'll receive a confirmation, occasional progress updates as launch approaches, and first access to the Complete Bundle and every individual book the moment they go live.
